## Materials research case study
### Fibre orientation in injection-moulded thermoplastics
- Case study: https://likavcan.cz/projects/fibre-orientation-injection-moulding/
- Research context: doctoral and co-authored work on injection moulding, short-fibre reinforced thermoplastics, fibre orientation, materialography and numerical simulation
- Evidence: peer-reviewed publications, DOI/publisher records and MTF STU doctoral records
- Interpretation rule: simulation output is not treated as an engineering conclusion without context and comparison to physical evidence where verification is required.

## Featured project
